lines.en: My bones rattle as I walk.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根一步一步来
lines.en: I come along the wall, one step at a time.
My steps have no weight.
I work my way down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂着，晃来晃去
lines.en: My arms hang and swing.
I step around the rubble.
I squeeze through the doorway.
My skull is a little askew.
I turn slowly to find my bearings.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方没有脚印
lines.en: I leave no prints where I pass.
I close in, step by step.
I drag one leg.
I stand, bones creaking.
I can see without eyes.
It is painfully bright here.
I listen for anything living.

lines.zh: 我的指骨敲着腿骨打拍
lines.en: My finger bones tap time on my thigh bone.
I do not move a single bone.
I raise a hand and look at it.

lines.zh: 我这副架子几乎没分量
lines.en: This frame of mine hardly weighs a thing.
I lean on a gravestone, waiting for someone.
My finger bones tap together.
Your heartbeat is loud enough to hurt my head.
My hollow eyes stay fixed on you.
My skull tilts toward you.
All your flesh is still on.
I raise my hand bones before your face.
You have no need to fear me.

lines.zh: 你身上的血肉还是新的
lines.en: Your flesh is still fresh.
I am counting your bones.
Your breathing has gone uneven.
I bring my face close to yours.
One of my bones has cracked.
My foot slips half a pace.
My arm hangs crooked.
That hurt the bone.
Some of my bones have come loose.
I fit myself back together.
I catch hold of the wall.
This frame of mine is still up.

lines.zh: 我断口处有碎屑落下来
lines.en: Bits of bone crumble from my broken end.
This frame can still move.
I do not eat.

lines.zh: 你举着这点东西干什么
lines.en: What are you holding that bit up for?

lines.zh: 这东西对骨头毫无用处
lines.en: That is of no use to bone at all.
I only want flesh and blood.
Take it back to your side.
I have no stomach.
I look, then look away.
You keep that.
I shake my head.
Take it away.
You hit my bones.
My kneecap catches for a moment.
A rib has come loose.
You knocked my ribs loose.
You stepped on my foot bone.

lines.zh: 我们撞到一处，骨头乱响
lines.en: We clash and the bones clatter.
I step back half a pace.
There was force in that.
My skull is knocked crooked.
I set myself straight.
I have been bones for a long while.
Such things rotted with my flesh.
I have no such thought.
I am the only one in this chamber.
There is no need for such words.
I angle my whole frame away.
I keep this place.
You are asking in the wrong direction.
I forgot long ago how to be close to anyone.
I take up my stride again.
I take whatever falls to the floor.
I pinch it between finger bones.
This is worth nothing.
It slips through my fingers.
I throw it back.
Whose it is, I pay no mind.
I tuck it between my ribs.
This thing lies across my path.
I walk over it.
I have no need of such a thing.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气我闻到了
lines.en: I smell the warmth on you.
I turn to face you.
I begin closing in.
You are ahead of me now.
My arm comes up.
Nothing here should be alive.
My mark is on you.
Do not plan on escaping.
I come one step at a time.
You will end up like me.
My jaw has dropped open.
I will not hold back this time.
I know that kind of breathing.
You are already too close.
I begin counting to three.
I have no heartbeat, and I will not stop.
My bones are creaking.

lines.zh: 我的影子先爬到你脚边
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet before I do.
My arm is raised.

lines.zh: 我的脚骨敲着地板追你
lines.en: My foot bones tap the floor as I chase you.
I do not tire.
My bones never stop clicking.
No one is coming here.
You are backed against the wall.
I am counting the gaps between your breaths.
I will not make the first sound.
Your blood is moving too fast.
I wait for you to show a gap.
One step between us.

lines.zh: 我的指骨已经握起来了
lines.en: My fingers have curled.
You will not block this.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地抬起另一只手
lines.en: I raise my other hand slowly.
Have you heard bones knock together?
I shift a little nearer.
Everything on my side is ready.
I make the last approach.
The time has come.
I swing my arm.

lines.zh: 我的骨节磕在你护甲上
lines.en: My knuckles knock against your armor.
You have taken a step back.
My knuckles caught you.
I raise my arm again.
My bone is harder than wood.
You blocked it, but your arms went numb.
My strikes have no form.
That will leave a mark.
I pause there.

lines.zh: 这一下我把全身都使上了
lines.en: That one used all of me.

lines.zh: 我的掌骨扫过你的胸口
lines.en: My hand bones sweep across your chest.
Half my forearm has come off.
I can still swing.

lines.zh: 我另一只手从侧面抓你
lines.en: My other hand reaches for you from the side.
I am enough for this place.
I climb up out of the earth.

lines.zh: 乱石堆里站起来一副骨头
lines.en: A set of bones stands up from the rubble.
I set my skull straight.
Something was buried here once.
I shake the earth off me.
I straighten my back slowly.
I raise a hand and look at it.
I have not moved in a long time.

lines.zh: 四下里一点声音都没有
lines.en: There is no sound anywhere.
I hear someone breathing.
Two steps before my bones settle.
I work my way out.
My jaw will not close.
My joints click back into place, one by one.
Fire blackens my bones.

lines.zh: 我的骨盆在落地时裂开
lines.en: My pelvis split when I hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水从我的肋骨缝里漏出去
lines.en: Water leaks out between my ribs.
The blast scatters me across the floor.
An arrow lodges between my ribs.
Magic burns inside my bones.
I have long had no need to eat.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，我一瞬间散又聚
lines.en: Lightning splits me apart, and I gather again.
The ground under me is suddenly gone.
